'''Bhii Padal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], gambler, and [[Pazaak/Legends|Pazaak]] player who was based out of [[Mek-Sha]]. At one point she partnered with the droid [[PH4-LNX]] in order to cheat at Pazaak, something which PH4-LNX found boring. Unbeknownst to PH4-LNX, Bhii copied some of her code to create a 'crude, but effective' cheating program and after PH4-LNX split off from Bhii, started to distribute it amongst other Pazaak players. PH4-LNX later learned of this and returned to Mek-Sha with the [[Alliance Commander]] to kill Bhii.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Season 3: Handling the Handler|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>
